title: Wellness Membership Agreement Schedule: Missed and Late-Cancelled Maintenance Sessions
content:
On the Wellness Membership tiers that include maintenance sessions, a missed or late-cancelled session may be forfeited; the forfeiture terms and the late-cancellation notice differ by tier.

| Tier | A no-show forfeits the session | A late cancellation forfeits the session | Notice below which a cancellation is late |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | No | No | 0 hours (no sessions on this tier) |
| Aquatic Access Membership | No | No | 0 hours (no sessions on this tier) |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | Yes | Yes | 24 hours |
| Wellness Plus Membership | Yes | Yes | 24 hours |
| Performance Membership | Yes | Yes | 24 hours |
| Performance Plus Membership | Yes | No | 24 hours |

## Footnotes to the schedule

1. A *no-show* is a booked maintenance session the member does not attend. Where the schedule reads "Yes", the session is forfeited instead of a fee.
2. A *late cancellation* is a cancellation of a booked maintenance session given with less than the notice shown for the tier. Where the schedule reads "Yes", the late-cancelled session is forfeited.
3. On the Performance Plus Membership a no-show forfeits the session, while the forfeiture column for a late cancellation reads "No".
4. The Open Gym Access Membership and the Aquatic Access Membership carry no maintenance sessions; their notice reads 0 hours.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical sessions on a 24-hour tier)

| Notice given before the session | Less than 24 hours? | Late cancellation? |
|---|---|---|
| 30 hours | No | No |
| exactly 24 hours | No | No |
| 23 hours | Yes | Yes |
